name: Buzz
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Braids' two unison-tuned band-limited pulse trains, summed. Harmonic count comes from a wavetable zone lookup, not a live additive sum, so the sweep is a flat spectrum with a hard cutoff moving through it, not a shaped one.

controls.label: Detune
controls.description: Detunes the second voice from unison, within whatever reach MACRO sets.

controls.label: Buzz
controls.description: Sweeps harmonic count upward from a bare sine to the fullest stack the module holds for that note.

controls.label: Spread
controls.description: Offsets the second voice's harmonic content away from the first, zero at noon.

controls.label: Reach
controls.description: Widens the detune past the module's own sub-semitone ceiling, up to an octave apart.

outputs.main: The two voices summed, or the first voice alone in stereo.
outputs.aux: The two voices' difference, or the second voice alone in stereo.
